items.v:
If you struggle with myopia (short-sightedness), hyperopia (long-sightedness), or astigmatism, you may be a candidate for FEMTO-LASIK — a safe and widely performed laser eye surgery trusted by millions worldwide.
At OPTIMAX Eye Specialist, we combine experience with cutting-edge laser systems to deliver highly personalized care. FEMTO-LASIK is one of our most popular procedures, offering faster recovery, high precision, and long-term visual clarity.

items.v: FEMTO-LASIK (Femtosecond LASIK) is a modern evolution of conventional LASIK that uses two lasers instead of a mechanical blade:

v: A femtosecond laser creates a thin, precise corneal flap
An excimer laser reshapes the cornea to correct refractive error

items.v:
This bladeless approach improves safety, comfort, and precision.
Technology Used at OPTIMAX
We use the SCHWIND AMARIS® excimer laser combined with Ziemer FEMTO LDV™ femtosecond laser for high-definition outcomes:

v: Ultra-thin, low-pressure flap creation
Intelligent eye tracking & fast ablation speed
High safety profile, tissue-conserving algorithm

items.v: Final treatment recommendation is determined during your consultation.

v: Bladeless and precise flap creation
Enhanced comfort and reduced flap complications
Rapid visual recovery
Treats a wide range of prescriptions

items.v: You may be suitable for FEMTO-LASIK if you:

v: Are 18 years or older with stable prescription
Have myopia, hyperopia, or astigmatism
Have adequate corneal thickness
Prefer a fast-recovery laser option

items.v: A full clinical assessment is needed to confirm eligibility.

no.heading: Who Is Not Suitable for FEMTO-LASIK?

items.v: FEMTO-LASIK may not be appropriate if you:

v: Have thin corneas or irregular topography
Are diagnosed with keratoconus or unstable vision
Are pregnant or nursing
Have chronic dry eyes or eye inflammation

items.v: Alternatives such as ZEISS SMILE® or TESA® may be recommended.
